query: Which repeated-measure or lagged-mediator design (number of waves, intervals, fraction re-sampled) should we pre-register to identify causal mediation for post-treatment profits?

response.query: Which repeated-measure or lagged-mediator design (number of waves, intervals, fraction re-sampled) should we pre-register to identify causal mediation for post-treatment profits?
response.answer: For causal mediation, pre-register a repeated-measure design with at least three waves to capture post-treatment profit changes over time. Use lagged mediators to account for temporal ordering. Ensure sufficient sample size for statistical power.
